func Test_CHK_051_CancellationCleansScratchAndStopsSetupGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
	childFinished := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-finished")
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'setup:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
sh -c 'sleep 2; printf finished > "$1"' sh %q &
printf ready > %q
wait
`, f.log, childFinished, ready))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(true)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("setup exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("setup never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled setup lacked C14: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("cancelled doctor retained Git registration: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	time.Sleep(2200 * time.Millisecond)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childFinished); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("cancelled setup descendant continued: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_054_MissingTemplatesAndCanaryMaps(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, body, term, input, affected string }{
		{"missing template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: [broken\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\n---\n", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"missing baseline", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 1\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "baseline", "undeclared"},
		{"missing internal_eval", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "missing_id:\n  evals/missing.txt: missing\n", "internal_eval", "internal_eval", "internal_eval"},
		{"wrong version", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 2\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed canary", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: [bad\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				start, end := strings.Index(body, "baseline:\n"), strings.Index(body, "undeclared:\n")
				if start < 0 || end <= start {
					t.Fatal("fixture cannot isolate baseline map")
				}
				tc.body = body[:start] + "baseline: {}\n" + body[end:]
			}
			if tc.name == "missing internal_eval" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				tc.body = strings.Replace(body, "internal_eval:\n  internal/private.txt: \"private\"\n  evals/internal.txt: \"{{module_dir}}\"\n", "", 1)
				if tc.body == body {
					t.Fatal("fixture did not remove internal_eval map")
				}
			}
			if tc.body == "" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				f.put(tc.path, tc.body)
			}
			f.commit()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.term) {
				t.Errorf("missing C14: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
			identified := false
			for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message+" "+d.Path), strings.ToLower(tc.input)) {
					identified = true
				}
			}
			if !identified {
				t.Errorf("C14 did not identify %s: %s", tc.input, doctorText(report))
			}
			if hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.affected, true) {
				t.Errorf("invalid recipe passed canary: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
		})
	}
}

	f.put(".fireweed/override-boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'override-boundaries:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\nexec sh .fireweed/boundary.sh\n", f.log))
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", strings.Replace(string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))), "depends_on: []", "depends_on: []\nhooks:\n  boundaries: sh .fireweed/override-boundary.sh", 1))
	f.put("packages/beta/SPEC.md", "---\nname: beta\nid_prefix: BET\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Beta\n\n## Specs\n\n### BET-001\nThe fixture MUST pass.\n")
	f.put("packages/beta/internal/live.txt", "disposable implementation\n")
	logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
	f.commit()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "X02", false, "beta", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("module without its own hook escaped required boundary enforcement: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
		t.Errorf("failed baseline beside override continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "override-boundaries:") {
		t.Errorf("applicable override was not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
}

			}

	}

		t.Errorf("audit did not receive its fixed-reply prompt: %s", log)
	}

	})

	bad := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), h.request(false))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(bad, "C15", false, "usage limit", "rate limit", "line-25") {
		t.Errorf("usage-limit tail missing: %s", doctorText(bad))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorText(bad), "line-01") {
		t.Errorf("agent output was not trimmed to final 20 lines: %s", doctorText(bad))
	}
	outOfTail := localDoctorFixture(t)

	outOfTail.commit()
	ordinary := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), outOfTail.request(false))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(ordinary, "C15", false, "agent.sh", "later-25") {
		t.Errorf("ordinary out-of-tail failure absent: %s", doctorText(ordinary))
	}
	for _, d := range ordinary.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code == "C15" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), "usage limit") {
			t.Errorf("out-of-tail pattern classified as usage limit: %s", doctorText(ordinary))
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, script string }{{"wrong reply", "#!/bin/bash\necho WRONG_REPLY\n"}, {"nonzero with reply", "#!/bin/bash\necho FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\nexit 7\n"}, {"ordinary failure", "#!/bin/bash\nfor i in $(seq 1 25); do printf 'ordinary-%02d\\n' \"$i\"; done\nexit 8\n"}} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			q := localDoctorFixture(t)
			q.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", tc.script)
			q.commit()

			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", false, "agent.sh") {
				t.Errorf("agent failure accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if tc.name == "ordinary failure" && (!hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", false, "ordinary-25") || strings.Contains(doctorText(r), "ordinary-01")) {
				t.Errorf("ordinary failure tail incorrect: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
		})
	}
	wrongAudit := localDoctorFixture(t)
	wrongAudit.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", "#!/bin/bash\necho WRONG_REPLY\n")
	wrongAudit.commit()
	auditFailure := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), wrongAudit.request(false))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(auditFailure, "C15", false, "audit.sh") || hasDoctorCheck(auditFailure, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("wrong audit reply accepted: %s", doctorText(auditFailure))
	}

	i := localDoctorFixture(t)
	i.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nsleep 2\n")
	i.commit()
	req := i.request(false)
	req.Timeout = 100 * time.Millisecond
	start := time.Now()
	timed := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(timed, "C15", false, "audit") || time.Since(start) > 4*time.Second {
		t.Errorf("audit timeout not bounded: %s; elapsed=%s", doctorText(timed), time.Since(start))
	}

	defaulted := localDoctorFixture(t)
	defaulted.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nsleep 0.2\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	defaulted.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nsleep 0.2\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	defaulted.commit()
	defaultRequest := defaulted.request(false)
	defaultRequest.Timeout = 0
	defaultReport := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), defaultRequest)
	if doctorErrors(defaultReport) || !hasDoctorCheck(defaultReport, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(defaultReport, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("unset timeout did not give both agent probes their default allowance: %s", doctorText(defaultReport))
	}

	j := localDoctorFixture(t)
	j.commit()
	skip := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), j.request(true))
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), "audit:") || !hasDoctorCheck(skip, "undeclared", true) || !strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), j.bin) {
		t.Errorf("NoAgent skipped hooks or ran agent: %s; log=%s", doctorText(skip), doctorLog(j))
	}

func Test_CHK_065_UnsetTimeoutBoundsAuditProbe(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit:%%s:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" \"$1\" >> %q\nprintf 'audit-timeout-started\n'\nsleep 210\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'\n", f.log))
	f.commit()
	req := f.request(false)
	req.Timeout = 0

	start := time.Now()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	log := doctorLog(f)
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || strings.Count(log, "worker:") != 1 || strings.Count(log, "audit:") != 1 {
		t.Errorf("agent probes did not run once with immediate worker reply: %s; log=%s", doctorText(report), log)
	}
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "audit.sh", "audit-timeout-started") {
		t.Errorf("long audit probe lacked a C15 timeout with its command and output: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if elapsed < 165*time.Second || elapsed > 200*time.Second {
		t.Errorf("unset audit timeout took %s, want a bound near three minutes", elapsed)
	}
}

func mustRead(t *testing.T, path string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b
}
func doctorBinary(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	_, file, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("caller")
	}
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(file), "..", "..", ".."))
	bin := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fireweed-new")
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", bin, ".")
	cmd.Dir = root
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GOCACHE=/tmp/fireweed-rebuild-cache")
	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build product: %v: %s", err, out)
	}
	return bin
}

+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}

+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}

+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd

+

+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`;Time string `xml:"time,attr"`;Failures []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`;Errors []junitIssue `xml:"error"`;Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitSuite struct {Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+type junitRoot struct {XMLName xml.Name;Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ var root junitRoot;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)}
+ report:=model.Report{};var visit func([]junitCase,[]junitSuite) error
+ visit=func(cases []junitCase,suites []junitSuite) error {for _,c:=range cases {
+  item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,Result:"pass"};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname) {item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}}
+  if len(item.IDs)==0 {for _,tok:=range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,-1) {return coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,tok)};return coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+  if c.Time!="" {v,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);if e!=nil{return coded("C11","testcase %q invalid time: %v",c.Name,e)};item.Seconds=v};report.Seconds+=item.Seconds
+  if len(c.Failures)+len(c.Errors)>0 {item.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,issue:=range append(c.Failures,c.Errors...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};item.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")} else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {item.Result="skip"}
+  report.Cases=append(report.Cases,item)
+ };for _,s:=range suites {if err:=visit(s.Cases,s.Suites);err!=nil{return err}};return nil};if err:=visit(root.Cases,root.Suites);err!=nil{return model.Report{},err};return report,nil
+}

+func RequirePass(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs {tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {if _,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tags[id])),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}};return nil}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func value(m map[string]any, keys ...string) any { for _,k:=range keys { if m==nil{return nil}; m=mapping(m[k]) }; return m }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch a:=v.(type) {case []string:return a;case []any: out:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a {if s,ok:=x.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)}};return out};return nil }
+func hasText(v any) bool {return strings.TrimSpace(str(v))!=""}
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\"'\"'")+"'" }
+func expand(s string, vars map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+ // A single replacer pass cannot recursively expand placeholders in values.
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} { if v,ok:=vars[k];ok {if shell {v=shellQuote(v)};pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)} };return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range x {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}

+func hookFor(config map[string]any,m project.Module,name string) any {if v:=mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name];v!=nil{return v};return mapping(config["hooks"])[name]}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context,request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules {if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module {m=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}

+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ raw:=hookFor(request.Snapshot.Config,*m,"eval");if raw==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ cmd,err:=parseCommand(raw);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ file,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};path:=file.Name();_ = file.Close();_ = os.Remove(path);defer os.Remove(path)
+ vars:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":path};result:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,request.Snapshot.Root,vars,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr};if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result=="fail" {failed=true;break}};if (result.exit==0)==failed{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=request.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};global:=mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]
+ // Global hooks run once; overrides run once for each module declaring one.
+ type task struct {label string;raw any};tasks:=[]task{};if global!=nil {tasks=append(tasks,task{"global",global})}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if raw:=mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])["boundaries"];raw!=nil {tasks=append(tasks,task{m.Name,raw})}}
+ baseline:=map[string]bool{};if data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));err==nil {for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if line!="" {baseline[line]=true}}}
+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=strings.TrimSpace(str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]));if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Warning:true,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt out: %s",m.Name,reason)})}
+  if global==nil&&mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])["boundaries"]==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:m.Name+": missing boundaries hook"})} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Warning:true,Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required"})}}
+ }
+ for _,task:=range tasks {cmd,err:=parseCommand(task.raw);if err!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:task.label+": "+err.Error()});continue};r:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,snap.Root,map[string]string{},map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:task.label+": "+r.err.Error()});continue}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};module:="";for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {module=m.Name;break}};if module=="" {continue};opted:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if m.Name==module&&hasText(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]) {opted=true;break}};if opted {continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line})}
+ }
+ for _,d:=range diags {if !d.Warning{return diags,fmt.Errorf("boundary violations")}};return diags,nil
+}
+var _=time.Second

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,change:=range request.Changes {paths:=[]string{change.Path};if change.OldPath!="" {paths=append(paths,change.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths {if !zoneAllows(request,path,change.Status,change.OldPath!=""&&path==change.OldPath) {out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot edit %s during %s",request.Module,path,request.Phase)})}}};return out}
+func zoneAllows(req model.ZoneRequest,path,status string,source bool)bool {
+ path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path=="."||strings.HasPrefix(path,"../")||filepath.IsAbs(path){return false}
+ if matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path)||strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/") {return false}
+ for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {dir:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(m.Dir)),"/");if path==dir+"/SPEC.md" {return false}}
+ if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/") {return path==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(req.ChangePath))}
+ if req.Phase=="audit" {return false}
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {target=m;break}}
+ if target==nil {return matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path)}
+ if target.Name!=req.Module {return false}
+ rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");if matchAny(target.Zones.Protected,rel){return false}
+ zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+ switch req.Phase {case "evals":switch zone {case "evals","other":return true;case "interface":return req.InterfaceDeclared;case "disposable":return !existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return false};case "impl":switch zone {case "evals","interface":return false;case "append_only":return !source&&strings.HasPrefix(status,"A")&&!existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return true}};return false
+}

		{"wrong version", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 2\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed canary", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: [bad\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {

				if start < 0 || end <= start {
					t.Fatal("fixture cannot isolate baseline map")
				}
				tc.body = body[:start] + "baseline: {}\n" + body[end:]
			}
			if tc.name == "missing internal_eval" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				tc.body = strings.Replace(body, "internal_eval:\n  internal/private.txt: \"private\"\n  evals/internal.txt: \"{{module_dir}}\"\n", "", 1)
				if tc.body == body {
					t.Fatal("fixture did not remove internal_eval map")
				}
			}
			if tc.body == "" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				f.put(tc.path, tc.body)
			}
			f.commit()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.term) {
				t.Errorf("missing C14: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
			identified := false
			for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message+" "+d.Path), strings.ToLower(tc.input)) {
					identified = true
				}
			}
			if !identified {
				t.Errorf("C14 did not identify %s: %s", tc.input, doctorText(report))
			}
			if hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.affected, true) {
				t.Errorf("invalid recipe passed canary: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
		})
	}
}

	j := localDoctorFixture(t)
	j.commit()
	skip := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), j.request(true))
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), "audit:") || !hasDoctorCheck(skip, "undeclared", true) || !strings.Contains(doctorLog(j), j.bin) {
		t.Errorf("NoAgent skipped hooks or ran agent: %s; log=%s", doctorText(skip), doctorLog(j))
	}
}

func Test_CHK_065_UnsetTimeoutBoundsAuditProbe(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit:%%s:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" \"$1\" >> %q\nprintf 'audit-timeout-started\n'\nsleep 210\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'\n", f.log))
	f.commit()
	req := f.request(false)
	req.Timeout = 0

	start := time.Now()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	log := doctorLog(f)
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || strings.Count(log, "worker:") != 1 || strings.Count(log, "audit:") != 1 {
		t.Errorf("agent probes did not run once with immediate worker reply: %s; log=%s", doctorText(report), log)
	}
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "audit.sh", "audit-timeout-started") {
		t.Errorf("long audit probe lacked a C15 timeout with its command and output: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if elapsed < 165*time.Second || elapsed > 200*time.Second {
		t.Errorf("unset audit timeout took %s, want a bound near three minutes", elapsed)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_068_CHK_069_ManagedGuidanceAndPlaybookBase(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	text, err := assets.Playbook("evals")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(text))
	base := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	f.put(".fireweed/playbooks/evals.md", "---\nembedded_base: "+base+"\n---\n# Local override\n")
	f.commit()
	r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", true) {
		t.Errorf("current guidance/base warned: %s", doctorText(r))
	}
	f.put("AGENTS.md", "Before.\n"+doctorGuidance+"After.\n")
	surrounded := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if hasDoctorDiagnostic(surrounded, "C16", true) {
		t.Errorf("current managed guidance with surrounding text warned: %s", doctorText(surrounded))
	}
	f.put("AGENTS.md", "Before.\n<!-- fireweed:start -->\nold guidance\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\nAfter.\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/playbooks/evals.md", "---\nembedded_base: stale\n---\n# Local override\n")
	stale := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(stale, "C16", true, "AGENTS.md") || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(stale, "C16", true, "evals") {
		t.Errorf("stale guidance/base not warned: %s", doctorText(stale))
	}
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, "AGENTS.md")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.put(".fireweed/playbooks/evals.md", "# No embedded base\n")
	missing := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(missing, "C16", true, "AGENTS.md") || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(missing, "C16", true, "evals") {
		t.Errorf("missing guidance/base not warned: %s", doctorText(missing))
	}
}

func mustRead(t *testing.T, path string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b
}
func doctorBinary(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	_, file, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("caller")
	}
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(file), "..", "..", ".."))
	bin := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fireweed-new")
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", bin, ".")
	cmd.Dir = root
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GOCACHE=/tmp/fireweed-rebuild-cache")
	if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build product: %v: %s", err, out)
	}
	return bin
}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"

+

+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitIssue struct {Message string `xml:"message,attr"`;Body string `xml:",chardata"`}
+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`;Time string `xml:"time,attr"`;Failures []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`;Errors []junitIssue `xml:"error"`;Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitSuite struct {Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+type junitRoot struct {XMLName xml.Name;Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ var root junitRoot;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)}
+ report:=model.Report{};var visit func([]junitCase,[]junitSuite) error
+ visit=func(cases []junitCase,suites []junitSuite) error {for _,c:=range cases {
+  item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,Result:"pass"};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname) {item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}}

package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
)

const doctorProbePrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"

func doctorRecordedPath(t *testing.T, log, label string) string {
	t.Helper()
	return doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, label, 1)[0]
}

func doctorRecordedPaths(t *testing.T, log, label string, count int) []string {
	t.Helper()
	var paths []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(log, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, label+":") {
			paths = append(paths, strings.TrimPrefix(line, label+":"))
		}
	}
	if len(paths) != count {
		t.Fatalf("%s paths = %q; want %d absolute paths", label, paths, count)
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			t.Fatalf("%s path = %q; want an absolute path", label, path)
		}
	}
	return paths
}

func doctorPromptFileRemoved(t *testing.T, path string) {
	t.Helper()
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("prompt file %q remains after probe: %v", path, err)
	}
}

test -f "$1" && printf '%%s' "$2" | cmp -s - "$1" || exit 11
shift 3
exec "$@"
`, f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash

test "$1" = "pre%spost" || exit 12
test "$2" != "file=" || exit 13

printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, f.log, doctorProbePrompt, doctorProbePrompt))
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'audit-prompt:%%s\naudit-file:%%s\naudit-common:%%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> %q
test -f "$2" && printf '%%s' "$1" | cmp -s - "$2" || exit 15
printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, f.log))
	f.commit()
	// Relocate the Git directory so its absolute path contains a quote, a space,
	// and another placeholder. The expanded value must remain literal.
	commonDir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "space 'quote' {prompt}", "repo.git")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(commonDir), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(filepath.Join(f.root, ".git"), commonDir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, ".git"), []byte("gitdir: "+commonDir+"\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("TMPDIR", filepath.Dir(commonDir))
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("prompt-file probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	log := doctorLog(f)
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(commonDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{
		"worker-prompt:pre" + doctorProbePrompt + "post", "audit-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt,
		"worker-common:" + common, "audit-common:" + common,
		"worker-literal:literal {unknown}",
		"wrap-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt, "wrap-common:" + common,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, want+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("missing exact argument %q", want)
		}
	}
	workerFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "worker-file")
	auditFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "audit-file")
	if workerFile == auditFile {
		t.Errorf("worker and audit reused prompt file %q", workerFile)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{workerFile, auditFile} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, "wrap-file:"+path+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("wrapper did not receive selected probe file %q", path)
		}
		doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
	}
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

func Test_CHK_083_DoctorRemovesPromptFileOnProbeFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"launch", "nonzero", "timeout", "cancel"} {

				if mode == "launch" {

					config["agent"].(map[string]any)["wrap"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
				}
			})
			f.put(".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\n' \"$1\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" || exit 11\nshift\nexec \"$@\"\n", f.log))
			script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\nworker-content:%%s\\n' \"$1\" \"$(cat \"$1\")\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" && printf '%%s' %q | cmp -s - \"$1\" || exit 18\nprintf ready > %q\n", f.log, doctorProbePrompt, ready)
			switch mode {
			case "nonzero":
				script += "printf 'failed worker stderr\\n' >&2\nexit 7\n"
			case "timeout", "cancel":
				script += "printf 'waiting worker stdout\\n'\nsleep 5\n"
			}
			f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", script)
			f.commit()
			status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
			req := f.request(false)
			if mode == "timeout" {
				req.Timeout = 2 * time.Second
			}
			ctx := context.Background()
			var cancel context.CancelFunc
			if mode == "cancel" {
				ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
				defer cancel()
			}
			var report checks.DoctorReport
			if mode == "cancel" {
				reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
				go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, req) }()
				deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
				for {
					if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
						break
					} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
						t.Fatal(err)

					select {

						t.Fatalf("worker exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
					case <-deadline:
						t.Fatal("worker never signalled readiness")
					case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
					}
				}
				livePath := doctorRecordedPath(t, doctorLog(f), "worker-file")
				if data, err := os.ReadFile(livePath); err != nil || string(data) != doctorProbePrompt {
					t.Errorf("prompt file unavailable before cancellation: %q, %v", data, err)
				}
				cancel()
				select {
				case report = <-reports:
				case <-time.After(4 * time.Second):
					t.Fatal("cancelled Doctor did not return")
				}
			} else {
				report = checks.Doctor(ctx, req)
			}
			if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "worker") {
				t.Errorf("%s probe outcome changed: %s", mode, doctorText(report))
			}
			log := doctorLog(f)
			count := 1

				// the subsequent audit probe; both files must be cleaned up.
				count = 2
			}
			paths := doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, "worker-file", count)
			if mode != "launch" && !strings.Contains(log, "worker-content:"+doctorProbePrompt+"\n") {
				t.Errorf("%s worker could not read exact prompt: %q", mode, log)
			}

				doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
			}
			doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker")
			doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
		})
	}
}

package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
)

func doctorProbeLog(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, report checks.DoctorReport, role string, markers ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var detail string
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if check.Name == role {
			detail = check.Detail
			break
		}
	}
	if detail == "" {
		t.Errorf("executed %s probe has no check: %s", role, doctorText(report))
		return ""
	}
	at := strings.Index(detail, "log: ")
	if at < 0 {
		t.Errorf("%s detail lacks log path: %q", role, detail)
		return ""
	}
	fields := strings.Fields(detail[at+len("log: "):])
	if len(fields) == 0 {
		t.Errorf("%s detail has empty log path: %q", role, detail)
		return ""
	}
	path := fields[0]
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		t.Errorf("%s log path is not absolute: %q", role, path)
	}
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed", "runs"), path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("%s log path %q: %v", role, path, err)
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(rel), "/")
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[0] == "." || parts[0] == ".." || parts[1] != "doctor-"+role+"-1.log" {
		t.Errorf("%s log path = %q, want .fireweed/runs/<run>/doctor-%s-1.log", role, path, role)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("read %s log %q: %v", role, path, err)
		return path
	}
	for _, marker := range markers {
		if !strings.Contains(string(data), marker) {
			t.Errorf("%s log lacks %q: %q", role, marker, data)
		}
	}
	return path
}

func doctorLogRun(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, worker, audit string, report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	t.Helper()
	base := filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed", "runs")
	w, ew := filepath.Rel(base, worker)
	a, ea := filepath.Rel(base, audit)
	if ew != nil || ea != nil {
		t.Errorf("log paths outside run root: %q %q: %v %v", worker, audit, ew, ea)
		return ""
	}
	wRun, aRun := filepath.Dir(w), filepath.Dir(a)
	if wRun != aRun || wRun == "." || wRun == ".." {
		t.Errorf("worker and audit have different run identities: %q %q: %s", worker, audit, doctorText(report))
	}
	return wRun
}

func doctorCallerClean(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, status, registrations string) {
	t.Helper()
	if got := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"); got != status {
		t.Errorf("caller status changed: before %q after %q", status, got)
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != registrations {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration changed: before %q after %q", registrations, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_081_DoctorProbeLogsShareFreshRunAndPreserveStreams(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker stdout Ω without newline'; printf 'worker stderr β without newline' >&2; printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit stdout Ω without newline'; printf 'audit stderr β without newline' >&2; printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	f.commit()
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	var firstRun string
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
		if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
			t.Errorf("successful probes changed outcome: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
		worker := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "worker stdout Ω without newlineFIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n", "worker stderr β without newline")
		audit := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "audit stdout Ω without newlineFIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n", "audit stderr β without newline")
		if worker != "" && audit != "" {
			run := doctorLogRun(t, f, worker, audit, report)
			if i == 1 && run == firstRun {
				t.Errorf("consecutive Doctor invocations reused run identity %q", run)
			}
			firstRun = run
		}
		doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_081_DoctorPersistsFailedAndTimedOutProbeOutput(t *testing.T) {
	failureStdout := "early worker stdout Ω\n"
	for i := 1; i <= 25; i++ {
		failureStdout += fmt.Sprintf("later-%02d\n", i)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, role, script, stdout, stderr string
		timeout                            time.Duration
	}{
		{"failure", "worker", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'early worker stdout Ω\\n'; for i in $(seq 1 25); do printf 'later-%02d\\n' \"$i\"; done; printf 'failed worker stderr β' >&2; exit 7\n", failureStdout, "failed worker stderr β", 2 * time.Second},
		{"timeout", "audit", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'partial audit stdout Ω'; printf 'partial audit stderr β' >&2; sleep 5\n", "partial audit stdout Ω", "partial audit stderr β", 150 * time.Millisecond},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.role == "worker" {
				f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", tc.script)
			} else {
				f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", tc.script)
			}
			f.commit()
			status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
			req := f.request(false)
			req.Timeout = tc.timeout
			start := time.Now()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
			if time.Since(start) > 4*time.Second {
				t.Errorf("%s probe did not honor bounded request timeout", tc.name)
			}
			if !hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.role, false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, tc.role, tc.stderr) {
				t.Errorf("%s probe outcome/diagnostic lost: %s", tc.name, doctorText(report))
			}
			path := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, tc.role, tc.stdout, tc.stderr)
			if tc.name == "failure" && path != "" {
				if !strings.Contains(string(mustRead(t, path)), "later-25") || strings.Contains(doctorText(report), "early worker stdout Ω") {
					t.Errorf("failed probe log or final-20-line diagnostic changed: %s", doctorText(report))
				}
			}
			doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
		})
	}
}

	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "worker-ready")

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"

+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func value(m map[string]any, keys ...string) any { for _,k:=range keys { if m==nil{return nil}; m=mapping(m[k]) }; return m }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch a:=v.(type) {case []string:return a;case []any: out:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a {if s,ok:=x.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)}};return out};return nil }
+func hasText(v any) bool {return strings.TrimSpace(str(v))!=""}
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\"'\"'")+"'" }
+func expand(s string, vars map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+ // A single replacer pass cannot recursively expand placeholders in values.
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} { if v,ok:=vars[k];ok {if shell {v=shellQuote(v)};pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)} };return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range x {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}

+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){cmd:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);out,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %v: %w: %s",args,err,out)};return string(out),nil}

+func hookFor(config map[string]any,m project.Module,name string) any {if v:=mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name];v!=nil{return v};return mapping(config["hooks"])[name]}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context,request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules {if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module {m=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",request.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ raw:=hookFor(request.Snapshot.Config,*m,"eval");if raw==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ cmd,err:=parseCommand(raw);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ file,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};path:=file.Name();_ = file.Close();_ = os.Remove(path);defer os.Remove(path)
+ vars:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":path};result:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,request.Snapshot.Root,vars,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr};if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}

+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result=="fail" {failed=true;break}};if (result.exit==0)==failed{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}

+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=request.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};global:=mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitIssue struct {Message string `xml:"message,attr"`;Body string `xml:",chardata"`}
+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`;Time string `xml:"time,attr"`;Failures []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`;Errors []junitIssue `xml:"error"`;Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitSuite struct {Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+type junitRoot struct {XMLName xml.Name;Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ var root junitRoot;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)}
+ report:=model.Report{};var visit func([]junitCase,[]junitSuite) error
+ visit=func(cases []junitCase,suites []junitSuite) error {for _,c:=range cases {
+  item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,Result:"pass"};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname) {item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}}
+  if len(item.IDs)==0 {for _,tok:=range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,-1) {return coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,tok)};return coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+  if c.Time!="" {v,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);if e!=nil{return coded("C11","testcase %q invalid time: %v",c.Name,e)};item.Seconds=v};report.Seconds+=item.Seconds
+  if len(c.Failures)+len(c.Errors)>0 {item.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,issue:=range append(c.Failures,c.Errors...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};item.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")} else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {item.Result="skip"}
+  report.Cases=append(report.Cases,item)
+ };for _,s:=range suites {if err:=visit(s.Cases,s.Suites);err!=nil{return err}};return nil};if err:=visit(root.Cases,root.Suites);err!=nil{return model.Report{},err};return report,nil
+}
+func tag(item contracts.Item,name string) bool {return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Tag)),name)}
+func references(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,v:=range c.IDs {if v==id{return true}};return false}
+func RequireCoverage(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if tag(s,"review")||tag(s,"quarantine"){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&references(c,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already {done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids {if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result=="fail"&&references(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs {tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {if _,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tags[id])),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,change:=range request.Changes {paths:=[]string{change.Path};if change.OldPath!="" {paths=append(paths,change.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths {if !zoneAllows(request,path,change.Status,change.OldPath!=""&&path==change.OldPath) {out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot edit %s during %s",request.Module,path,request.Phase)})}}};return out}
+func zoneAllows(req model.ZoneRequest,path,status string,source bool)bool {
+ path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path=="."||strings.HasPrefix(path,"../")||filepath.IsAbs(path){return false}
+ if matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path)||strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/") {return false}
+ for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {dir:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(m.Dir)),"/");if path==dir+"/SPEC.md" {return false}}
+ if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/") {return path==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(req.ChangePath))}
+ if req.Phase=="audit" {return false}
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {target=m;break}}
+ if target==nil {return matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path)}
+ if target.Name!=req.Module {return false}
+ rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");if matchAny(target.Zones.Protected,rel){return false}
+ zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+ switch req.Phase {case "evals":switch zone {case "evals","other":return true;case "interface":return req.InterfaceDeclared;case "disposable":return !existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return false};case "impl":switch zone {case "evals","interface":return false;case "append_only":return !source&&strings.HasPrefix(status,"A")&&!existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return true}};return false
+}

+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range a {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}

+func Doctor(ctx context.Context,request model.DoctorRequest)model.DoctorReport{r:=model.DoctorReport{};root,err:=filepath.Abs(request.Root);if err!=nil{doctorDiagnostic(&r,"C14",err.Error(),"",false);return r};r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,project.Check(root)...);doctorWarnings(root,&r);for _,d:=range r.Diagnostics {if !d.Warning{return r}}

+ snap,err:=project.Load(scratch);if err!=nil{doctorDiagnostic(&r,"C14","scratch project: "+err.Error(),"",false);return r};setup:=mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["setup"];if setup!=nil {cmd,e:=parseCommand(setup);if e!=nil {doctorDiagnostic(&r,"C14","setup hook: "+e.Error(),"",false);return r};res:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,scratch,nil,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout);if res.err!=nil||res.exit!=0 {doctorDiagnostic(&r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v %s",res.err,res.stderr),"",false);return r}}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "bytes"
+ "fmt"
+ "os/exec"

+ "sort"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"

+
+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){cmd:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);out,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %v: %w: %s",args,err,out)};return string(out),nil}
+type historyPath struct{path,old,status string}
+func diffPaths(root,parent,commit string)([]historyPath,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};paths:=[]historyPath{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out),"\n") {if line==""{continue};fields:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(fields)<2{continue};p:=historyPath{status:fields[0],path:fields[len(fields)-1]};if strings.HasPrefix(p.status,"R")&&len(fields)>2{p.old=fields[1]};paths=append(paths,p)};return paths,nil}
+func changeDocs(root,commit string)(map[string]struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document},error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",commit,"changes");if err!=nil{return nil,err};docs:=map[string]struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document}{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out),"\n") {if !strings.HasSuffix(p,".md")||!(strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/")||strings.Count(p,"/")==1){continue};data,err:=fileAt(root,commit,p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s at %s: %w",p,commit,err)};docs[filepath.Base(p)]=struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document}{p,str(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]),doc}};return docs,nil}
+func recordedZone(path string,before,after project.Snapshot,kind string,projected []string)bool {for _,snap:=range []project.Snapshot{before,after} {for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/");var patterns []string;switch kind {case "append_only":patterns=m.Zones.AppendOnly;case "evals":patterns=m.Zones.Evals;case "interface":patterns=m.Zones.Interface};if matchAny(patterns,rel)||matchAny(projected,rel){return true}}}};return false}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){result:=model.HistoryReport{};root,err:=filepath.Abs(root);if err!=nil{return result,err}

+ cmd,err:=parseCommand(raw);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ file,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};path:=file.Name();_ = file.Close();_ = os.Remove(path);defer os.Remove(path)

+}
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=request.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};global:=mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitIssue struct {Message string `xml:"message,attr"`;Body string `xml:",chardata"`}
+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`;Time string `xml:"time,attr"`;Failures []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`;Errors []junitIssue `xml:"error"`;Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitSuite struct {Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+type junitRoot struct {XMLName xml.Name;Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ var root junitRoot;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)}
+ report:=model.Report{};var visit func([]junitCase,[]junitSuite) error
+ visit=func(cases []junitCase,suites []junitSuite) error {for _,c:=range cases {
+  item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,Result:"pass"};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname) {item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}}
+  if len(item.IDs)==0 {for _,tok:=range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,-1) {return coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,tok)};return coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+  if c.Time!="" {v,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);if e!=nil{return coded("C11","testcase %q invalid time: %v",c.Name,e)};item.Seconds=v};report.Seconds+=item.Seconds
+  if len(c.Failures)+len(c.Errors)>0 {item.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,issue:=range append(c.Failures,c.Errors...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};item.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")} else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {item.Result="skip"}
+  report.Cases=append(report.Cases,item)
+ };for _,s:=range suites {if err:=visit(s.Cases,s.Suites);err!=nil{return err}};return nil};if err:=visit(root.Cases,root.Suites);err!=nil{return model.Report{},err};return report,nil
+}
+func tag(item contracts.Item,name string) bool {return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Tag)),name)}
+func references(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,v:=range c.IDs {if v==id{return true}};return false}
+func RequireCoverage(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if tag(s,"review")||tag(s,"quarantine"){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&references(c,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already {done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids {if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result=="fail"&&references(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs {tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {if _,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tags[id])),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,change:=range request.Changes {paths:=[]string{change.Path};if change.OldPath!="" {paths=append(paths,change.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths {if !zoneAllows(request,path,change.Status,change.OldPath!=""&&path==change.OldPath) {out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot edit %s during %s",request.Module,path,request.Phase)})}}};return out}
+func zoneAllows(req model.ZoneRequest,path,status string,source bool)bool {
+ path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path=="."||strings.HasPrefix(path,"../")||filepath.IsAbs(path){return false}
+ if matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path)||strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/") {return false}
+ for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {dir:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(m.Dir)),"/");if path==dir+"/SPEC.md" {return false}}
+ if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/") {return path==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(req.ChangePath))}
+ if req.Phase=="audit" {return false}
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {target=m;break}}
+ if target==nil {return matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path)}
+ if target.Name!=req.Module {return false}
+ rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");if matchAny(target.Zones.Protected,rel){return false}
+ zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+ switch req.Phase {case "evals":switch zone {case "evals","other":return true;case "interface":return req.InterfaceDeclared;case "disposable":return !existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return false};case "impl":switch zone {case "evals","interface":return false;case "append_only":return !source&&strings.HasPrefix(status,"A")&&!existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return true}};return false
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aea6fd4f8b08e9b53776117cc84c5c1120781c2f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func value(m map[string]any, keys ...string) any { for _,k:=range keys { if m==nil{return nil}; m=mapping(m[k]) }; return m }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch a:=v.(type) {case []string:return a;case []any: out:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a {if s,ok:=x.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)}};return out};return nil }
+func hasText(v any) bool {return strings.TrimSpace(str(v))!=""}
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\"'\"'")+"'" }
+func expand(s string, vars map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+ // A single replacer pass cannot recursively expand placeholders in values.
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} { if v,ok:=vars[k];ok {if shell {v=shellQuote(v)};pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)} };return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range x {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"

+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt="Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const managedGuidance="<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+func doctorDiagnostic(r *model.DoctorReport,code,msg,path string,warning bool){r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Message:msg,Path:path,Warning:warning})}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport,name,module string,passed bool,detail string){r.Checks=append(r.Checks,model.DoctorCheck{Name:name,Module:module,Passed:passed,Detail:detail})}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitIssue struct {Message string `xml:"message,attr"`;Body string `xml:",chardata"`}
+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`;Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`;Time string `xml:"time,attr"`;Failures []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`;Errors []junitIssue `xml:"error"`;Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitSuite struct {Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+type junitRoot struct {XMLName xml.Name;Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`;Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){
+ var root junitRoot;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+ if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)}
+ report:=model.Report{};var visit func([]junitCase,[]junitSuite) error
+ visit=func(cases []junitCase,suites []junitSuite) error {for _,c:=range cases {
+  item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,Result:"pass"};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname) {item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}}
+  if len(item.IDs)==0 {for _,tok:=range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,-1) {return coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,tok)};return coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)}
+  if c.Time!="" {v,e:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);if e!=nil{return coded("C11","testcase %q invalid time: %v",c.Name,e)};item.Seconds=v};report.Seconds+=item.Seconds
+  if len(c.Failures)+len(c.Errors)>0 {item.Result="fail";parts:=[]string{};for _,issue:=range append(c.Failures,c.Errors...) {if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Message);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)};if s:=strings.TrimSpace(issue.Body);s!="" {parts=append(parts,s)}};item.Failure=strings.Join(parts,"\n")} else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {item.Result="skip"}
+  report.Cases=append(report.Cases,item)
+ };for _,s:=range suites {if err:=visit(s.Cases,s.Suites);err!=nil{return err}};return nil};if err:=visit(root.Cases,root.Suites);err!=nil{return model.Report{},err};return report,nil
+}
+func tag(item contracts.Item,name string) bool {return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Tag)),name)}
+func references(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,v:=range c.IDs {if v==id{return true}};return false}
+func RequireCoverage(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if tag(s,"review")||tag(s,"quarantine"){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="skip"&&references(c,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already {done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids {if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result=="fail"&&references(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs {tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range r.Cases {if c.Result!="fail" {continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs {if _,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tags[id])),"quarantine") {return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,id)}}};return nil}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,change:=range request.Changes {paths:=[]string{change.Path};if change.OldPath!="" {paths=append(paths,change.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths {if !zoneAllows(request,path,change.Status,change.OldPath!=""&&path==change.OldPath) {out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot edit %s during %s",request.Module,path,request.Phase)})}}};return out}
+func zoneAllows(req model.ZoneRequest,path,status string,source bool)bool {
+ path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path=="."||strings.HasPrefix(path,"../")||filepath.IsAbs(path){return false}
+ if matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path)||strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/") {return false}
+ for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {dir:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(m.Dir)),"/");if path==dir+"/SPEC.md" {return false}}
+ if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/") {return path==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(req.ChangePath))}
+ if req.Phase=="audit" {return false}
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {target=m;break}}
+ if target==nil {return matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path)}
+ if target.Name!=req.Module {return false}
+ rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");if matchAny(target.Zones.Protected,rel){return false}
+ zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+ switch req.Phase {case "evals":switch zone {case "evals","other":return true;case "interface":return req.InterfaceDeclared;case "disposable":return !existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return false};case "impl":switch zone {case "evals","interface":return false;case "append_only":return !source&&strings.HasPrefix(status,"A")&&!existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return true}};return false
+}

import (
