const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
const managedGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"

func doctorDiagnostic(r *model.DoctorReport, code, msg, path string, warning bool) {
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: path, Warning: warning})
}
func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, passed bool, detail string) {
	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: passed, Detail: detail})
}
func copyCurrent(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, e := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if rel == "." {
			return nil
		}
		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			if d.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if rel == filepath.Join(".fireweed", "runs") {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if d.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
		}
		if !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		info, e := d.Info()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		in, e := os.Open(path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		defer in.Close()
		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		out, e := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_WRONLY, info.Mode().Perm())
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		_, e = io.Copy(out, in)
		closeErr := out.Close()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		return closeErr
	})
}
func doctorWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), managedGuidance) {
		doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance is missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
	}
	files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "playbooks", "*.md"))
	for _, path := range files {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md")
		embedded, e2 := assets.Playbook(name)
		if e != nil || e2 != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", name+": embedded_base is missing or stale", path, true)
			continue
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded))
		if str(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"]) != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", name+": embedded_base is missing or stale", path, true)
		}
	}
}
func doctorScratch(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
	common, err := gitOutput(root, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	common = strings.TrimSpace(common)
	common, err = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	if err = os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	scratch, err := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(scratch)
	_, err = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD")
	if err != nil {
		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	cleanup := func() {
		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
	}
	if err = copyCurrent(root, scratch); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	return scratch, common, cleanup, nil
}
func renderCanary(s string, vars map[string]string) string {
	pairs := []string{}
	for _, k := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
		pairs = append(pairs, "{{"+k+"}}", vars[k])
	}
	return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
}
func writeCanaryMap(root, dir string, files map[string]string, vars map[string]string) error {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(files))
	for k := range files {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, k := range keys {
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(k, ".tmpl")
		if name == "" || filepath.IsAbs(name) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(name), "..") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid canary path %q", k)
		}
		path := filepath.Join(root, dir, filepath.FromSlash(name))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(renderCanary(files[k], vars)), 0644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func readCanaryMaps(root string) (map[string]map[string]string, error) {
	path := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "canaries", "canaries.yaml")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: %w", err)
	}
	var raw struct {
		Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
		Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
		Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
		InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
		FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
		MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
	}
	if err = yaml.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: %w", err)
	}
	if raw.Version != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: expected version 1")
	}
	maps := map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": raw.Baseline, "undeclared": raw.Undeclared, "internal_eval": raw.InternalEval, "failing_eval": raw.FailingEval, "missing_id": raw.MissingID}
	for k, v := range maps {
		if len(v) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s map missing in canaries.yaml", k)
		}
	}
	return maps, nil
}
func readTemplates(root string) (map[string]string, error) {
	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "templates", "module")
	files := map[string]string{}
	err := filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, e := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		files[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", err)
	}
	if _, ok := files["SPEC.md"]; !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md missing")
	}
	return files, nil
}
func doctorModule(root, name, prefix, other, goModule string, templates, baseline map[string]string) (project.Module, error) {
	dir := "packages/" + name
	vars := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
	if err := writeCanaryMap(root, dir, templates, vars); err != nil {
		return project.Module{}, err
	}
	if err := writeCanaryMap(root, dir, baseline, vars); err != nil {
		return project.Module{}, err
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, dir, "SPEC.md"))
	if err != nil {
		return project.Module{}, err
	}
	doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
	if err != nil {
		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
	}
	if str(doc.Frontmatter["name"]) != name {
		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md has wrong name")
	}
	return project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: dir, Document: doc}, nil
}
func doctorHooks(ctx context.Context, root, bin string, timeout time.Duration, m project.Module, evalRaw, boundaryRaw any) (model.Report, []project.Diagnostic, error) {
	snap := project.Snapshot{Root: root, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": evalRaw, "boundaries": boundaryRaw}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
	r, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
	if err != nil {
		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval hook: %w", err)
	}
	if err = RequireCoverage(r, mustSpecs(m)); err != nil {
		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval coverage: %w", err)
	}
	if err = RequirePass(r, mustSpecs(m)); err != nil {
		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval hook: %w", err)
	}

func doctorProbeAgent(ctx context.Context, r *model.DoctorReport, root, scratch, common, runID, role string, config map[string]any, timeout time.Duration) {
	agent := mapping(config["agent"])
	raw := agent["command"]
	if role == "audit" {
		if v := mapping(config["audit"])["command"]; v != nil {
			raw = v

	}

	var wrap command

		wrap, err = parseCommand(wrapRaw)
		if err != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+err.Error(), "", false)

		}
	}
	vars := map[string]string{"prompt": doctorPrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
	if cmd.uses("{prompt_file}") || wrap.uses("{prompt_file}") {
		f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-")
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
			return
		}
		_, e = f.WriteString(doctorPrompt)
		_ = f.Close()
		if e != nil {
			_ = os.Remove(f.Name())
			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
			return
		}
		vars["prompt_file"] = f.Name()
		defer os.Remove(f.Name())
	}
	selected := cmd
	display := cmd.display()
	if wrapRaw != nil {
		if wrap.shell != "" {
			joined := cmd.shell
			if joined == "" {
				parts := []string{}
				for _, a := range cmd.argv {
					parts = append(parts, shellQuote(expand(a, vars, false)))
				}
				joined = strings.Join(parts, " ")
			}
			selected = command{shell: wrap.shell + " " + joined}
		} else {
			args := append([]string{}, wrap.argv...)
			if cmd.shell != "" {
				args = append(args, "sh", "-c", cmd.shell)
			} else {
				args = append(args, cmd.argv...)
			}
			selected = command{argv: args}
		}
	}
	result := runCommand(ctx, selected, scratch, vars, nil, timeout)
	logPath := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", runID, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
	_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(logPath), 0755)
	_ = os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(result.stdout+result.stderr), 0644)
	success := result.err == nil && result.exit == 0 && strings.Contains(result.stdout, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	detail := "log: " + logPath
	doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
	if success {
		return
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(result.stdout+"\n"+result.stderr, "\n"), "\n")
	if len(lines) > 20 {
		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
	}
	tail := strings.Join(lines, "\n")
	kind := "command failure"
	for _, pattern := range stringsOf(config["limit_patterns"]) {
		if pattern != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(pattern)) {
			kind = "usage limit"
			break
		}
	}
	doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s (exit %d): %s %v", role, kind, display, result.exit, tail, result.err), "", false)
}
func Doctor(ctx context.Context, request model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
	r := model.DoctorReport{}
	root, err := filepath.Abs(request.Root)
	if err != nil {
		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", err.Error(), "", false)
		return r
	}
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(root)...)
	doctorWarnings(root, &r)
	for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return r
		}
	}
	scratch, common, cleanup, err := doctorScratch(root)
	if err != nil {
		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "scratch worktree: "+err.Error(), "", false)
		return r
	}
	defer cleanup()
	snap, err := project.Load(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "scratch project: "+err.Error(), "", false)
		return r
	}
	setup := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["setup"]
	if setup != nil {
		cmd, e := parseCommand(setup)
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "setup hook: "+e.Error(), "", false)
			return r
		}
		res := runCommand(ctx, cmd, scratch, nil, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin}, request.Timeout)
		if res.err != nil || res.exit != 0 {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v %s", res.err, res.stderr), "", false)
			return r
		}
	}
	// Warnings for real modules remain visible even if canaries fail.
	realBoundary, _ := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
	for _, d := range realBoundary {
		if d.Code == "X03" || d.Code == "X04" || d.Code == "X02" {
			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
		}
	}
	templates, err := readTemplates(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "module template: "+err.Error(), "", false)
		return r
	}
	maps, err := readCanaryMaps(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "canary: "+err.Error(), "", false)
		return r
	}
	goModule := ""
	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); e == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
				goModule = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
				break
			}
		}
	}
	seed := time.Now().UnixNano()
	names := []string{fmt.Sprintf("doctor%d", seed%1000000000), fmt.Sprintf("doctor%d", (seed+1)%1000000000)}
	dirs := []string{"packages/" + names[0], "packages/" + names[1]}
	modules := []project.Module{}
	for i, name := range names {
		other := dirs[1-i]
		prefix := fmt.Sprintf("DOC%d", i+1)
		m, e := doctorModule(scratch, name, prefix, other, goModule, templates, maps["baseline"])
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "module template or baseline canary: "+e.Error(), "", false)
			return r
		}
		modules = append(modules, m)
	}
	// Make both modules visible to hooks that invoke the configured executable.
	configPath := filepath.Join(scratch, "fireweed.yaml")
	if data, e := os.ReadFile(configPath); e == nil {
		var config map[string]any
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config) == nil {
			mods := stringsOf(config["modules"])
			mods = append(mods, dirs...)
			config["modules"] = mods
			if b, e := yaml.Marshal(config); e == nil {
				_ = os.WriteFile(configPath, b, 0644)
			}
		}
	}
	globalEval := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["eval"]
	globalBoundary := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]
	variants := []struct {
		label          string
		eval, boundary any
	}{{"global", globalEval, globalBoundary}}
	for _, real := range snap.Modules {
		hooks := mapping(real.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])
		if hooks["eval"] != nil || hooks["boundaries"] != nil {
			eval := globalEval
			boundary := globalBoundary
			if hooks["eval"] != nil {
				eval = hooks["eval"]
			}
			if hooks["boundaries"] != nil {
				boundary = hooks["boundaries"]
			}
			variants = append(variants, struct {
				label          string
				eval, boundary any
			}{real.Name, eval, boundary})
		}
	}
	for i, variant := range variants {
		m := modules[i%len(modules)]
		if variant.eval == nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", variant.label+" baseline eval hook missing", "", false)
			continue
		}
		if variant.boundary == nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", variant.label+" baseline boundaries hook missing", "", false)
			for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", name+" boundaries hook missing", "", false)
			}
			continue
		}
		_, _, e := doctorHooks(ctx, scratch, request.Bin, request.Timeout, m, variant.eval, variant.boundary)
		doctorCheck(&r, "baseline", m.Name, e == nil, variant.label)
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s baseline %v", variant.label, e), "", false)
			continue
		}
		vars := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": dirs[1-(i%len(modules))]}
		for _, canary := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
			files := maps[canary]
			written := []string{}
			for path := range files {
				written = append(written, filepath.Join(scratch, m.Dir, filepath.FromSlash(strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".tmpl"))))
			}
			if e = writeCanaryMap(scratch, m.Dir, files, vars); e != nil {
				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", canary+" canary: "+e.Error(), "", false)
				continue
			}
			detected := false
			hook := "boundaries"
			switch canary {
			case "undeclared", "internal_eval":
				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"boundaries": variant.boundary}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
				ds, _ := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
				for _, d := range ds {
					if d.Code == "X01" && strings.Contains(d.Message, m.Name+":") && (canary != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), "interface")) {
						detected = true
					}
				}
			case "failing_eval":
				hook = "eval"
				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": variant.eval}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
				rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
				if e == nil && rep.HookExit != 0 {
					for _, c := range rep.Cases {
						if c.Result == "fail" && references(c, m.IDPrefix+"-001") {
							detected = true
						}
					}
				}
			case "missing_id":
				hook = "eval"
				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": variant.eval}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
				_, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
				detected = e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "unknown spec ID")
			}
			doctorCheck(&r, canary, m.Name, detected, variant.label)
			if !detected {
				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s hook missed canary %s", variant.label, hook, canary), "", false)
			}
			for _, path := range written {
				_ = os.Remove(path)
			}
			_, _, recovery := doctorHooks(ctx, scratch, request.Bin, request.Timeout, m, variant.eval, variant.boundary)
			doctorCheck(&r, "recovery "+canary, m.Name, recovery == nil, variant.label)
			if recovery != nil {
				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s recovery after %s %v", variant.label, canary, recovery), "", false)
			}
		}
	}
	if !request.NoAgent && ctx.Err() == nil {
		runID := fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
		for _, role := range []string{"worker", "audit"} {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				break
			}
			doctorProbeAgent(ctx, &r, root, scratch, common, runID, role, snap.Config, request.Timeout)
		}
	}
	return r
}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func value(m map[string]any, keys ...string) any { for _,k:=range keys { if m==nil{return nil}; m=mapping(m[k]) }; return m }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch a:=v.(type) {case []string:return a;case []any: out:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a {if s,ok:=x.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)}};return out};return nil }
+func hasText(v any) bool {return strings.TrimSpace(str(v))!=""}
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\"'\"'")+"'" }
+func expand(s string, vars map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+ // A single replacer pass cannot recursively expand placeholders in values.
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} { if v,ok:=vars[k];ok {if shell {v=shellQuote(v)};pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)} };return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range x {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const managedGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+func doctorDiagnostic(r *model.DoctorReport, code, msg, path string, warning bool) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: path, Warning: warning})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, passed bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: passed, Detail: detail})
+}
+func copyCurrent(src, dst string) error {
+	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(src, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if rel == "." {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return filepath.SkipDir
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == filepath.Join(".fireweed", "runs") {
+			return filepath.SkipDir
+		}
+		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
+		}
+		if !d.Type().IsRegular() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		info, e := d.Info()
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		in, e := os.Open(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		defer in.Close()
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		out, e := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_WRONLY, info.Mode().Perm())
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		_, e = io.Copy(out, in)
+		closeErr := out.Close()
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		return closeErr
+	})
+}
+func doctorWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
+	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), managedGuidance) {
+		doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance is missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
+	}
+	files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "playbooks", "*.md"))
+	for _, path := range files {
+		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md")
+		embedded, e2 := assets.Playbook(name)
+		if e != nil || e2 != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", name+": embedded_base is missing or stale", path, true)
+			continue
+		}
+		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded))
+		if str(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"]) != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C16", name+": embedded_base is missing or stale", path, true)
+		}
+	}
+}
+func doctorScratch(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
+	common, err := gitOutput(root, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	common = strings.TrimSpace(common)
+	common, err = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
+	if err = os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); err != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	scratch, err := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	_ = os.Remove(scratch)
+	_, err = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD")
+	if err != nil {
+		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	cleanup := func() {
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
+		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
+		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
+	}
+	if err = copyCurrent(root, scratch); err != nil {
+		cleanup()
+		return "", "", nil, err
+	}
+	return scratch, common, cleanup, nil
+}
+func renderCanary(s string, vars map[string]string) string {
+	pairs := []string{}
+	for _, k := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
+		pairs = append(pairs, "{{"+k+"}}", vars[k])
+	}
+	return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+func writeCanaryMap(root, dir string, files map[string]string, vars map[string]string) error {
+	keys := make([]string, 0, len(files))
+	for k := range files {
+		keys = append(keys, k)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(keys)
+	for _, k := range keys {
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(k, ".tmpl")
+		if name == "" || filepath.IsAbs(name) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(name), "..") {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid canary path %q", k)
+		}
+		path := filepath.Join(root, dir, filepath.FromSlash(name))
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0755); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(renderCanary(files[k], vars)), 0644); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func readCanaryMaps(root string) (map[string]map[string]string, error) {
+	path := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "canaries", "canaries.yaml")
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: %w", err)
+	}
+	var raw struct {
+		Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
+		Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
+		Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
+		InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
+		FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
+		MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
+	}
+	if err = yaml.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: %w", err)
+	}
+	if raw.Version != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: expected version 1")
+	}
+	maps := map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": raw.Baseline, "undeclared": raw.Undeclared, "internal_eval": raw.InternalEval, "failing_eval": raw.FailingEval, "missing_id": raw.MissingID}
+	for k, v := range maps {
+		if len(v) == 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s map missing in canaries.yaml", k)
+		}
+	}
+	return maps, nil
+}
+func readTemplates(root string) (map[string]string, error) {
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "templates", "module")
+	files := map[string]string{}
+	err := filepath.WalkDir(base, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(base, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		files[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
+		return nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", err)
+	}
+	if _, ok := files["SPEC.md"]; !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md missing")
+	}
+	return files, nil
+}
+func doctorModule(root, name, prefix, other, goModule string, templates, baseline map[string]string) (project.Module, error) {
+	dir := "packages/" + name
+	vars := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
+	if err := writeCanaryMap(root, dir, templates, vars); err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, err
+	}
+	templateData, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	if err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(templateData)); err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
+	}
+	if err := writeCanaryMap(root, dir, baseline, vars); err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, err
+	}
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	if err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, err
+	}
+	doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
+	if err != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
+	}
+	if str(doc.Frontmatter["name"]) != name {
+		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md has wrong name")
+	}
+	return project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: dir, Document: doc}, nil
+}
+func doctorHooks(ctx context.Context, root, bin string, timeout time.Duration, m project.Module, evalRaw, boundaryRaw any) (model.Report, []project.Diagnostic, error) {
+	snap := project.Snapshot{Root: root, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": evalRaw, "boundaries": boundaryRaw}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
+	r, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
+	if err != nil {
+		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval hook: %w", err)
+	}
+	if err = RequireCoverage(r, mustSpecs(m)); err != nil {
+		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval coverage: %w", err)
+	}
+	if err = RequirePass(r, mustSpecs(m)); err != nil {
+		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("eval hook: %w", err)
+	}
+	if boundaryRaw == nil {
+		return r, nil, fmt.Errorf("boundaries hook missing")
+	}
+	d, e := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, d, fmt.Errorf("boundaries hook: %w", e)
+	}
+	return r, d, nil
+}
+func mustSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item { items, _ := moduleSpecs(m); return items }
+func doctorProbeAgent(ctx context.Context, r *model.DoctorReport, root, scratch, common, runID, role string, config map[string]any, timeout time.Duration) {
+	agent := mapping(config["agent"])
+	raw := agent["command"]
+	if role == "audit" {
+		if v := mapping(config["audit"])["command"]; v != nil {
+			raw = v
+		} else {
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", "audit uses shared agent command; audit-specific command blind spot", "", true)
+		}
+	}
+	cmd, err := parseCommand(raw)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+err.Error(), "", false)
+		return
+	}
+	wrapRaw := agent["wrap"]
+	var wrap command
+	if wrapRaw != nil {
+		wrap, err = parseCommand(wrapRaw)
+		if err != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+err.Error(), "", false)
+			return
+		}
+	}
+	vars := map[string]string{"prompt": doctorPrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
+	if cmd.uses("{prompt_file}") || wrap.uses("{prompt_file}") {
+		f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-")
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return
+		}
+		_, e = f.WriteString(doctorPrompt)
+		_ = f.Close()
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = os.Remove(f.Name())
+			doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", role+": "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return
+		}
+		vars["prompt_file"] = f.Name()
+		defer os.Remove(f.Name())
+	}
+	selected := cmd
+	display := cmd.display()
+	if wrapRaw != nil {
+		if wrap.shell != "" {
+			joined := expand(cmd.shell, vars, true)
+			if joined == "" {
+				parts := []string{}
+				for _, a := range cmd.argv {
+					parts = append(parts, shellQuote(expand(a, vars, false)))
+				}
+				joined = strings.Join(parts, " ")
+			}
+			selected = command{shell: expand(wrap.shell, vars, true) + " " + joined}
+		} else {
+			args := []string{}
+			for _, a := range wrap.argv { args = append(args, expand(a, vars, false)) }
+			if cmd.shell != "" {
+				args = append(args, "sh", "-c", expand(cmd.shell, vars, true))
+			} else {
+				for _, a := range cmd.argv { args = append(args, expand(a, vars, false)) }
+			}
+			selected = command{argv: args}
+		}
+		vars = nil
+	}
+	result := runCommand(ctx, selected, scratch, vars, nil, timeout)
+	logPath := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", runID, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(logPath), 0755)
+	_ = os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(result.stdout+result.stderr), 0644)
+	success := result.err == nil && result.exit == 0 && strings.Contains(result.stdout, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
+	detail := "log: " + logPath
+	doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
+	if success {
+		return
+	}
+	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(result.stdout+"\n"+result.stderr, "\n"), "\n")
+	if len(lines) > 20 {
+		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
+	}
+	tail := strings.Join(lines, "\n")
+	kind := "command failure"
+	for _, pattern := range stringsOf(config["limit_patterns"]) {
+		if pattern != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(pattern)) {
+			kind = "usage limit"
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	doctorDiagnostic(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s (exit %d): %s %v", role, kind, display, result.exit, tail, result.err), "", false)
+}
+func Doctor(ctx context.Context, request model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
+	r := model.DoctorReport{}
+	root, err := filepath.Abs(request.Root)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", err.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(root)...)
+	doctorWarnings(root, &r)
+	for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	scratch, common, cleanup, err := doctorScratch(root)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "scratch worktree: "+err.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	defer cleanup()
+	snap, err := project.Load(scratch)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "scratch project: "+err.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	setup := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["setup"]
+	if setup != nil {
+		cmd, e := parseCommand(setup)
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "setup hook: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		res := runCommand(ctx, cmd, scratch, nil, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin}, request.Timeout)
+		if res.err != nil || res.exit != 0 {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v %s", res.err, res.stderr), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	// Warnings for real modules remain visible even if canaries fail.
+	realBoundary, _ := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
+	for _, d := range realBoundary {
+		if d.Code == "X03" || d.Code == "X04" || d.Code == "X02" {
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+		}
+	}
+	templates, err := readTemplates(scratch)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "module template: "+err.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	maps, err := readCanaryMaps(scratch)
+	if err != nil {
+		doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "canary: "+err.Error(), "", false)
+		return r
+	}
+	goModule := ""
+	if data, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); e == nil {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
+				goModule = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	seed := time.Now().UnixNano()
+	names := []string{fmt.Sprintf("doctor%d", seed%1000000000), fmt.Sprintf("doctor%d", (seed+1)%1000000000)}
+	dirs := []string{"packages/" + names[0], "packages/" + names[1]}
+	modules := []project.Module{}
+	for i, name := range names {
+		other := dirs[1-i]
+		prefix := []string{"DCA", "DCB"}[i]
+		m, e := doctorModule(scratch, name, prefix, other, goModule, templates, maps["baseline"])
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", "module template or baseline canary: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+			return r
+		}
+		modules = append(modules, m)
+	}
+	// Make both modules visible to hooks that invoke the configured executable.
+	configPath := filepath.Join(scratch, "fireweed.yaml")
+	if data, e := os.ReadFile(configPath); e == nil {
+		var config map[string]any
+		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config) == nil {
+			mods := stringsOf(config["modules"])
+			mods = append(mods, dirs...)
+			config["modules"] = mods
+			if b, e := yaml.Marshal(config); e == nil {
+				_ = os.WriteFile(configPath, b, 0644)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	globalEval := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["eval"]
+	globalBoundary := mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]
+	variants := []struct {
+		label          string
+		eval, boundary any
+	}{}
+	needGlobal := len(snap.Modules)==0
+	for _, real := range snap.Modules { hooks:=mapping(real.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"]); if hooks["eval"]==nil && hooks["boundaries"]==nil {needGlobal=true} }
+	if needGlobal { variants=append(variants,struct{label string;eval,boundary any}{"global",globalEval,globalBoundary}) }
+	for _, real := range snap.Modules {
+		hooks := mapping(real.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])
+		if hooks["eval"] != nil || hooks["boundaries"] != nil {
+			eval := globalEval
+			boundary := globalBoundary
+			if hooks["eval"] != nil {
+				eval = hooks["eval"]
+			}
+			if hooks["boundaries"] != nil {
+				boundary = hooks["boundaries"]
+			}
+			variants = append(variants, struct {
+				label          string
+				eval, boundary any
+			}{real.Name, eval, boundary})
+		}
+	}
+	for i, variant := range variants {
+		m := modules[i%len(modules)]
+		if variant.eval == nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", variant.label+" baseline eval hook missing", "", false)
+			continue
+		}
+		if variant.boundary == nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", variant.label+" baseline boundaries hook missing", "", false)
+			for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
+				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", name+" boundaries hook missing", "", false)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		_, _, e := doctorHooks(ctx, scratch, request.Bin, request.Timeout, m, variant.eval, variant.boundary)
+		doctorCheck(&r, "baseline", m.Name, e == nil, variant.label)
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s baseline %v", variant.label, e), "", false)
+			continue
+		}
+		vars := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": dirs[1-(i%len(modules))]}
+		for _, canary := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
+			files := maps[canary]
+			written := []string{}
+			for path := range files {
+				written = append(written, filepath.Join(scratch, m.Dir, filepath.FromSlash(strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".tmpl"))))
+			}
+			if e = writeCanaryMap(scratch, m.Dir, files, vars); e != nil {
+				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", canary+" canary: "+e.Error(), "", false)
+				continue
+			}
+			detected := false
+			hook := "boundaries"
+			switch canary {
+			case "undeclared", "internal_eval":
+				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"boundaries": variant.boundary}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
+				ds, _ := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
+				for _, d := range ds {
+					if d.Code == "X01" && strings.Contains(d.Message, m.Name+":") && (canary != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), "interface")) {
+						detected = true
+					}
+				}
+			case "failing_eval":
+				hook = "eval"
+				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": variant.eval}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
+				rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
+				if e == nil && rep.HookExit != 0 {
+					for _, c := range rep.Cases {
+						if c.Result == "fail" && references(c, m.IDPrefix+"-001") {
+							detected = true
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			case "missing_id":
+				hook = "eval"
+				snap := project.Snapshot{Root: scratch, Config: map[string]any{"hooks": map[string]any{"eval": variant.eval}}, Modules: []project.Module{m}}
+				_, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: request.Bin, Timeout: request.Timeout})
+				detected = e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "unknown spec ID")
+			}
+			doctorCheck(&r, canary, m.Name, detected, variant.label)
+			if !detected {
+				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s hook missed canary %s", variant.label, hook, canary), "", false)
+			}
+			for _, path := range written {
+				_ = os.Remove(path)
+			}
+			_, _, recovery := doctorHooks(ctx, scratch, request.Bin, request.Timeout, m, variant.eval, variant.boundary)
+			doctorCheck(&r, "recovery "+canary, m.Name, recovery == nil, variant.label)
+			if recovery != nil {
+				doctorDiagnostic(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s recovery after %s %v", variant.label, canary, recovery), "", false)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if !request.NoAgent && ctx.Err() == nil {
+		runID := fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
+		for _, role := range []string{"worker", "audit"} {
+			if ctx.Err() != nil {
+				break
+			}
+			doctorProbeAgent(ctx, &r, root, scratch, common, runID, role, snap.Config, request.Timeout)
+		}
+	}
+	return r
+}

+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){cmd:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);out,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %v: %w: %s",args,err,out)};return string(out),nil}
+type historyPath struct{path,old,status string}
+func diffPaths(root,parent,commit string)([]historyPath,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};paths:=[]historyPath{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out),"\n") {if line==""{continue};fields:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(fields)<2{continue};p:=historyPath{status:fields[0],path:fields[len(fields)-1]};if strings.HasPrefix(p.status,"R")&&len(fields)>2{p.old=fields[1]};paths=append(paths,p)};return paths,nil}
+func changeDocs(root,commit string)(map[string]struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document},error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",commit,"changes");if err!=nil{return nil,err};docs:=map[string]struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document}{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out),"\n") {if !strings.HasSuffix(p,".md")||!(strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/")||strings.Count(p,"/")==1){continue};data,err:=fileAt(root,commit,p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s at %s: %w",p,commit,err)};docs[filepath.Base(p)]=struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document}{p,str(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]),doc}};return docs,nil}
+func recordedZone(path string,before,after project.Snapshot,kind string,projected []string)bool {for _,snap:=range []project.Snapshot{before,after} {for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/");var patterns []string;switch kind {case "append_only":patterns=m.Zones.AppendOnly;case "evals":patterns=m.Zones.Evals;case "interface":patterns=m.Zones.Interface};if matchAny(patterns,rel)||matchAny(projected,rel){return true}}}};return false}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){result:=model.HistoryReport{};root,err:=filepath.Abs(root);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+ if revisionRange=="" {snap,err:=project.Load(root);if err!=nil{return result,err};base:=str(snap.Config["base"]);if base=="" {return result,fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")};ref,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse","--verify",base);if err!=nil{return result,err};merge,err:=gitOutput(root,"merge-base","HEAD",strings.TrimSpace(ref));if err!=nil{return result,err};revisionRange=strings.TrimSpace(merge)+"..HEAD"}
+ out,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--reverse","--topo-order",revisionRange);if err!=nil{return result,err};for _,commit:=range strings.Fields(out){result.Commits=append(result.Commits,commit)}
+ for _,commit:=range result.Commits {parentLine,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};parents:=strings.Fields(parentLine);if len(parents)>0 {parents=parents[1:]};after,err:=project.LoadAt(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};afterDocs,err:=changeDocs(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+  beforeSnaps:=[]project.Snapshot{};parentDocs:=[]map[string]struct{path,phase string;doc contracts.Document}{};allChanges:=[]historyPath{};seen:=map[string]bool{}
+  for _,parent:=range parents {snap,err:=project.LoadAt(root,parent);if err!=nil{return result,err};beforeSnaps=append(beforeSnaps,snap);docs,err:=changeDocs(root,parent);if err!=nil{return result,err};parentDocs=append(parentDocs,docs);changes,err:=diffPaths(root,parent,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};for _,c:=range changes {key:=c.status+"\x00"+c.old+"\x00"+c.path;if !seen[key] {seen[key]=true;allChanges=append(allChanges,c)}}}
+  if len(parents)==0 {changes,err:=diffPaths(root,"4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904",commit);if err==nil{allChanges=changes}}
+  type transition struct {path,phase,previous string;projectedInterface []string};transitions:=[]transition{};names:=make([]string,0,len(afterDocs));for name:=range afterDocs {names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names)
+  for _,name:=range names {doc:=afterDocs[name];if doc.phase=="" {continue};retained:=false;previous:="";for _,pdocs:=range parentDocs {if p,ok:=pdocs[name];ok {if p.phase==doc.phase {retained=true};if p.phase=="impl" {previous="impl"}}};if retained {continue};set:=mapping(doc.doc.Frontmatter["set"]);transitions=append(transitions,transition{doc.path,doc.phase,previous,stringsOf(set["interface"])});if doc.phase=="applied"&&previous!="impl" {result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:commit,Change:doc.path})}}
+  add:=func(code,path string){result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s in commit %s",code,path,commit)})}
+  for _,c:=range allChanges {p:=c.path;old:=c.old;if old==""{old=p};existing:=!strings.HasPrefix(c.status,"A")
+   // A rename may land in an append-only zone even if the source was elsewhere.
+   if existing {hit:=false;for _,before:=range beforeSnaps {if recordedZone(old,before,after,"append_only",nil)||recordedZone(p,before,after,"append_only",nil){hit=true}};if hit {add("H03",old)}}
+   if strings.HasPrefix(old,"changes/archive/")&&existing&&!strings.HasPrefix(c.status,"D") {add("H04",old)}
+   active:=false;appliedFromImpl:=false;projected:=[]string{};squashed:=false;for _,t:=range transitions {if t.phase=="applied"&&t.previous!="impl" {squashed=true};if t.phase=="audit"||t.phase=="impl"||t.phase=="applied" {active=true};if t.phase=="applied"&&t.previous=="impl" {appliedFromImpl=true;projected=append(projected,t.projectedInterface...)}}

+
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){section,ok:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");if !ok{return nil,nil};items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(section);if err!=nil {if code,_,ok:=contracts.ErrorCode(err);ok {return nil,coded(code,"%v",err)};return nil,err};return items,nil}
+func hookFor(config map[string]any,m project.Module,name string) any {if v:=mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name];v!=nil{return v};return mapping(config["hooks"])[name]}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context,request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+ var m *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules {if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module {m=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+ if m==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",request.Module)}
+ specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*m);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+ raw:=hookFor(request.Snapshot.Config,*m,"eval");if raw==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",m.Name)}
+ cmd,err:=parseCommand(raw);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","%v",err)}
+ file,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};path:=file.Name();_ = file.Close();_ = os.Remove(path);defer os.Remove(path)
+ vars:=map[string]string{"module":m.Name,"module_dir":m.Dir,"report":path};result:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,request.Snapshot.Root,vars,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout)
+ report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr};if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}
+ data,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+ parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+ failed:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases {if c.Result=="fail" {failed=true;break}};if (result.exit==0)==failed{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}
+ return report,nil
+}
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context,request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+ snap:=request.Snapshot;diags:=[]project.Diagnostic{};global:=mapping(snap.Config["hooks"])["boundaries"]
+ // Global hooks run once; overrides run once for each module declaring one.
+ type task struct {label string;raw any};tasks:=[]task{};if global!=nil {tasks=append(tasks,task{"global",global})}

+ for _,m:=range snap.Modules {reason:=strings.TrimSpace(str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]));if reason!="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X03",Warning:true,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt out: %s",m.Name,reason)})}
+  if global==nil&&mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])["boundaries"]==nil {if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&reason=="" {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:m.Name+": missing boundaries hook"})} else {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X04",Warning:true,Message:m.Name+": no boundary enforcement required"})}}
+ }
+ for _,task:=range tasks {cmd,err:=parseCommand(task.raw);if err!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:task.label+": "+err.Error()});continue};r:=runCommand(ctx,cmd,snap.Root,map[string]string{},map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin},request.Timeout);if r.err!=nil {diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X02",Message:task.label+": "+r.err.Error()});continue}
+  for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line] {continue};module:="";for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":") {module=m.Name;break}};if module=="" {continue};opted:=false;for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if m.Name==module&&hasText(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]) {opted=true;break}};if opted {continue};diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:"X01",Message:line})}
+ }
+ for _,d:=range diags {if !d.Warning{return diags,fmt.Errorf("boundary violations")}};return diags,nil
+}

diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..128ce4446d372044ced78a0eb86d77ba05868447
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"regexp"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitIssue struct {
+	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
+	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
+}
+type junitCase struct {
+	Name      string       `xml:"name,attr"`
+	Classname string       `xml:"classname,attr"`
+	Time      string       `xml:"time,attr"`
+	Failures  []junitIssue `xml:"failure"`
+	Errors    []junitIssue `xml:"error"`
+	Skipped   []struct{}   `xml:"skipped"`
+}
+type junitSuite struct {
+	Cases  []junitCase  `xml:"testcase"`
+	Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`
+}
+type junitRoot struct {
+	XMLName xml.Name
+	Cases   []junitCase  `xml:"testcase"`
+	Suites  []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`
+}
+
+var idToken = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
+	var root junitRoot
+	if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
+		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
+	}
+	if root.XMLName.Local != "testsuite" && root.XMLName.Local != "testsuites" {
+		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", root.XMLName.Local)
+	}
+	report := model.Report{}
+	var visit func([]junitCase, []junitSuite) error
+	visit = func(cases []junitCase, suites []junitSuite) error {
+		for _, c := range cases {
+			item := model.Case{Name: c.Name, Classname: c.Classname, Result: "pass"}
+			for _, s := range specs {
+				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Classname) {
+					item.IDs = append(item.IDs, s.ID)
+				}
+			}
+			if len(item.IDs) == 0 {
+				for _, tok := range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname, -1) {
+					for _, spec := range specs {
+						prefix := strings.SplitN(spec.ID, "-", 2)[0]
+						if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(tok), strings.ToUpper(prefix)) {
+							return coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, tok)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+				return coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
+			}
+			if c.Time != "" {
+				v, e := strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time, 64)
+				if e != nil {
+					return coded("C11", "testcase %q invalid time: %v", c.Name, e)
+				}
+				item.Seconds = v
+			}
+			report.Seconds += item.Seconds
+			if len(c.Failures)+len(c.Errors) > 0 {
+				item.Result = "fail"
+				parts := []string{}
+				for _, issue := range append(c.Failures, c.Errors...) {
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(issue.Message); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+					if s := strings.TrimSpace(issue.Body); s != "" {
+						parts = append(parts, s)
+					}
+				}
+				item.Failure = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
+			} else if len(c.Skipped) > 0 {
+				item.Result = "skip"
+			}
+			report.Cases = append(report.Cases, item)
+		}
+		for _, s := range suites {
+			if err := visit(s.Cases, s.Suites); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := visit(root.Cases, root.Suites); err != nil {
+		return model.Report{}, err
+	}
+	return report, nil
+}
+func tag(item contracts.Item, name string) bool {
+	return strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Tag)), name)
+}
+func references(c model.Case, id string) bool {
+	for _, v := range c.IDs {
+		if v == id {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func RequireCoverage(r model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	for _, s := range specs {
+		if tag(s, "review") || tag(s, "quarantine") {
+			continue
+		}
+		found := false
+		for _, c := range r.Cases {
+			if c.Result != "skip" && references(c, s.ID) {
+				found = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !found {
+			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
+	done := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, id := range already {
+		done[id] = true
+	}
+	for _, id := range ids {
+		if done[id] {
+			continue
+		}
+		ok := false
+		for _, c := range r.Cases {
+			if c.Result == "fail" && references(c, id) {
+				ok = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func RequirePass(r model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
+	tags := map[string]string{}
+	for _, s := range specs {
+		tags[s.ID] = s.Tag
+	}
+	for _, c := range r.Cases {
+		if c.Result != "fail" {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, id := range c.IDs {
+			if _, ok := tags[id]; ok && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tags[id])), "quarantine") {
+				return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s", c.Name, id)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+var _ = fmt.Sprintf

+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest) []project.Diagnostic {out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,change:=range request.Changes {paths:=[]string{change.Path};if change.OldPath!="" {paths=append(paths,change.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths {if !zoneAllows(request,path,change.Status,change.OldPath!=""&&path==change.OldPath) {out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s cannot edit %s during %s",request.Module,path,request.Phase)})}}};return out}
+func zoneAllows(req model.ZoneRequest,path,status string,source bool)bool {
+ path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));if path=="."||strings.HasPrefix(path,"../")||filepath.IsAbs(path){return false}
+ if matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path)||strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/") {return false}
+ for _,m:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {dir:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(m.Dir)),"/");if path==dir+"/SPEC.md" {return false}}
+ if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/") {return path==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(req.ChangePath))}
+ if req.Phase=="audit" {return false}
+ var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules {m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(m.Dir,"/")+"/") {target=m;break}}
+ if target==nil {return matchAny(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path)}
+ if target.Name!=req.Module {return false}
+ rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,strings.TrimSuffix(target.Dir,"/")+"/");if matchAny(target.Zones.Protected,rel){return false}
+ zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+ switch req.Phase {case "evals":switch zone {case "evals","other":return true;case "interface":return req.InterfaceDeclared;case "disposable":return !existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return false};case "impl":switch zone {case "evals","interface":return false;case "append_only":return !source&&strings.HasPrefix(status,"A")&&!existsAt(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);default:return true}};return false
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..aea6fd4f8b08e9b53776117cc84c5c1120781c2f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any { m,_:=v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func value(m map[string]any, keys ...string) any { for _,k:=range keys { if m==nil{return nil}; m=mapping(m[k]) }; return m }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string); return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch a:=v.(type) {case []string:return a;case []any: out:=[]string{};for _,x:=range a {if s,ok:=x.(string);ok {out=append(out,s)}};return out};return nil }
+func hasText(v any) bool {return strings.TrimSpace(str(v))!=""}
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\"'\"'")+"'" }
+func expand(s string, vars map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+ // A single replacer pass cannot recursively expand placeholders in values.
+ pairs:=[]string{}; for _,k:=range []string{"module","module_dir","report","prompt","prompt_file","git_common_dir"} { if v,ok:=vars[k];ok {if shell {v=shellQuote(v)};pairs=append(pairs,"{"+k+"}",v)} };return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...).Replace(s)
+}
+type command struct {shell string; argv []string}
+func parseCommand(v any) (command,error) {switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return command{},errors.New("empty hook command")};return command{shell:x},nil;case []string:if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};return command{argv:x},nil;case []any: if len(x)==0{return command{},errors.New("empty hook argv")};a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,p:=range x {s,ok:=p.(string);if !ok{return command{},errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,s)};return command{argv:a},nil;default:return command{},errors.New("missing or invalid hook command")}}
+func (c command) uses(s string) bool {if strings.Contains(c.shell,s){return true};for _,a:=range c.argv {if strings.Contains(a,s){return true}};return false}
+func (c command) display() string {if c.shell!="" {return c.shell};return strings.Join(c.argv," ")}
+type commandResult struct {stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error}
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, c command, dir string, vars map[string]string, env map[string]string, timeout time.Duration) commandResult {
+ if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute};ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel()
+ var cmd *exec.Cmd
+ if c.shell!="" {cmd=exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(c.shell,vars,true))} else {args:=make([]string,len(c.argv));for i,a:=range c.argv {args[i]=expand(a,vars,false)};if len(args)==0{return commandResult{err:errors.New("empty command")}};cmd=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...)}
+ cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+ // Put each hook in a process group so timeout/cancellation also stops children.
+ cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+ var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+ err:=cmd.Start();if err!=nil{return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}}
+ done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+ select {case err=<-done:case <-ctx.Done():_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);err=<-done;return commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:ctx.Err()}}
+ result:=commandResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String()};if err!=nil {var e *exec.ExitError;if errors.As(err,&e){result.exit=e.ExitCode()}else{result.err=err}};return result
+}
+func fileAt(root,rev,path string) ([]byte,error) {cmd:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"show",rev+":"+path);return cmd.Output()}
+func existsAt(root,rev,path string) bool {if rev=="" {_,e:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return e==nil};_,e:=fileAt(root,rev,path);return e==nil}
+func matchAny(patterns []string,path string) bool {for _,p:=range patterns {if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func intExit(r commandResult) string{return strconv.Itoa(r.exit)}
